verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official, first-party MCP server for Gitea (gitea-mcp, hosted under the gitea organization on gitea.com). That directly covers the core of connecting an agent through an official MCP server, but the evidence is a single existence probe with no detail on scope or setup. Missing for 10: documentation of the exposed tools/capabilities, setup and auth instructions for connecting agents, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
